# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes: it describes the repository layout, the build, test and
DevFlow commands, and the architecture rules. Load the matching skill from `.github/skills` for MAUI-specific work.

Always validate UI changes on a running app with DevFlow (screenshot, visual tree, layout diagnostics) in both
light and dark themes, not only by building.
